Package geometries

Class Intersectable.Intersection

java.lang.Object
geometries.Intersectable.Intersection
Enclosing class:
Intersectable
public static class Intersectable.Intersection extends Object
Represents a single intersection point between a ray and a geometric object. This inner class holds information about the geometry, the intersection point itself, and additional properties relevant for shading calculations.
